items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: He was a little fella playing drum with us, you see.

ctx.x: Yeah, he first started, a little fella they called Tommy Henderson. He was a little fella playing drum with us, you see. He was a nice little drummer. So, well, we played, we rehearsed it every three times a week and then after that, we went after that, one night, it rained, it rained all day and all night. It was the Beville Park on Beville Street. Beville? Yeah, on Beville Street there. Newton, you see after you leave Tash, you see. Tash, Newton, Nunes, Ferret, Villette. And next, see, the next street, that's…
Yeah, yeah, Beville Park used to call it. See that?
